name: Making Money in Leonida
summary: A progression-aware earning guide covering early-game limits, repeatable activities, vehicle fencing, and later bank work.
description: Money systems open over the story, so the best route changes by chapter. Launch guides describe small early earnings, vehicle fencing through Moses after its story unlock, and higher-value bank jobs later. Avoid spending time on a method before its buyer or activity is available; use the in-game progress counters to confirm each payout.

steps.title: Do not over-grind early story chapters
steps.content: Early opportunities pay modestly and some chapter transitions can reset carried progress. Complete story objectives and unlock the relevant buyers before farming.
steps.tip: Keep a manual save before a major chapter transition if you are testing a money route.

steps.title: Use the vehicle fence when it unlocks
steps.content: After the Moses story introduction, deliver eligible stolen cars to the buyer and follow his requirements. Tracked or otherwise ineligible vehicles can be rejected.
steps.tip: Inspect the vehicle and buyer prompt before driving across the map.

steps.title: Complete activity and robbery objectives
steps.content: Gang Operations, business robberies, and optional jobs provide money while also contributing to the completion checklist. Loot required valuables and finish the activity’s escape/objective steps.
steps.tip: Use map filters to chain nearby jobs rather than repeating a low-paying activity.

steps.title: Save high-value bank work for its unlocks
steps.content: Later story progression opens bank jobs and vault-related opportunities. Prepare an escape route, watch the heat level, and deposit cash when safe.
steps.tip: The 100% checklist tracks some fencing totals separately from cash earned, so check the exact counter.

requirements: Progress through the story to unlock buyers and higher-value activities.
Check the in-game tracker for separate cash and fenced-goods totals.
commonMistakes: Expecting late-game payouts before the relevant story unlock.
Driving an ineligible or tracked car to a fence.
Assuming cash earnings and fenced-goods totals are the same statistic.
